Maya Patel: Quick sync on webinar + launch posts. Need a short PLG vs enterprise split for landing pages and a 2-line exec soundbite. Also want SDR-ready QA lines.

Jon Rivera: Proposal: demo CTA -> enterprise/dedicated, benchmark CTA -> PLG/dev. Exec soundbite: "Ship LLM features faster with a production-first inference platform that controls latency and unit economics across environments."

Samir Khan: For the benchmark claim, lead with a comparative narrative: caching + batching profiles reduce unit cost while preserving p95 latency under load. Avoid raw numbers in headline.

Elaine Cho: Agreed. Headline: "Lower unit costs without trading away p95 latency" with a methodology appendix link. For infra vendor rebuttal: "Self-hosted needs ops; Redwood pairs runtime performance with turnkey routing and observability."

Maya Patel: Routing: /launch/webinar-bench primary CTA -> benchmark signup; secondary CTA -> schedule demo (company email required). Add UTM params: webinar_bench and webinar_demo.

Samir Khan: Deck micro-outline: Problem -> Measurement (p95 + cost/1k tokens) -> Result (cache/batch wins) -> Takeaway (choose platform that optimizes product SLAs).

Elaine Cho: Ops-bot, can you wire events for the CTAs?

ops-bot: Event hooks created: webinar_bench_cta_click, webinar_demo_cta_click, webinar_signup_complete. Pings marketing-analytics. :robot_face:

Jon Rivera: Webinar title suggestion: "Serving Real-World LLMs: Benchmarks, Routing, and Cost Controls"

Samir Khan: SDR QA bullets (short):
- When to push a demo? -> Enterprise, SLA, or regulated data asks.
- Whats the bench claim? -> Lower unit economics while preserving p95 latency (link to method).
- Objection: We self-host -> Self-host needs ops; Redwood provides runtime + rollouts + routing.

Elaine Cho: I'll draft the SDR Slack snippet and the appendix note. Maya, need final by EOD to freeze messaging.

Maya Patel: Thanks team :rocket: Freeze reminder scheduled for 24h prior.
